CustomField.label: Source Query Field
CustomField.description: The API name of the field or aggregate alias to read from the "Source Query" result. Needed when the Source Query returns field values, or when it uses an aliased aggregate such as SUM(Amount) totalAmount (enter totalAmount here). Leave blank only for bare COUNT(), which returns the count directly.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Column or aggregate alias from the Source Query, e.g. MailingCity or totalAmount. Leave blank only for bare COUNT().
